propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos annua beatae Agnetis Virginis et Martyris tuae solemnitate
laetificas; da, quaesumus; ut, quam veneramur officio, etiam piae
conversationis sequamur exemplo. Per Dominum.

Agnete Secreta' in the commemoration within the Mass of 28 January; artifact PDF p. 540, left column), not on any text layer, and the string the 2026-09-04 backfill had stored and quarantined for recogniser damage was not used. Every word was then read on the 1862 Pustet at printed p. 397, Die xxviii, S. Agnetis Virginis et Martyris Secundo, Secreta, read on the page image of its registered facsimile PDF at p. 483 (text-layer address lines 57237-57243), which carries the text word for word. Differences from the antecedent: the 1862 sets no comma after quaesumus; the 1862 prints the short conclusion cue Per Dominum where the 1962 writes it out; the 1962 sets no comma between Christum and Filium, as read on the 400 dpi image. The antecedent recorded by the 2026-09-04 lane (1862 lines 62194-62211, the Holy Cross Secret pro SS. Alexandro) reads de Sanctorum where this text reads de Martyrum, a different word; the correct antecedent is the 1862's own Agnes secundo formulary on 28 January, read here on its page image.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Super has, quaesumus, Domine, hostias benedictio copiosa descendat: quae et
sanctificationem nobis clementer operetur, et de Martyrum nos solemnitate
laetificet. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit
et regnat in unitate.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Sumpsimus, Domine, celebritatis annuae votiva sacramenta: praesta,
quaesumus; ut et temporalis vitae nobis remedia praebeant, et aeternae. Per
Dominum.
